recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見大型細胞，核卵圓、核膜清楚纖細、染色質淡而細、核仁小而居中，其中有雙核相貼的細胞，細胞質淡粉且邊界不清，符合生發中心內的濾泡樹突細胞（FDC），並夾雜中心母細胞與巨噬細胞。
features: Large cells with oval nuclei, thin sharp nuclear membranes, pale finely dispersed chromatin and small central nucleoli
Binucleate cell with two closely apposed nuclei (characteristic of follicular dendritic cells)
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders (syncytial appearance)
Admixed cells with vesicular nuclei and peripheral nucleoli (centroblasts)
Scattered small dark nuclear fragments/lymphocytes and a cell with dense pink cytoplasm
describe_en: High-power H&E section shows large cells with oval nuclei, delicate nuclear membranes, pale chromatin and small central nucleoli, including a binucleate form with closely apposed nuclei, set within ill-defined pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. These are admixed with centroblast-like cells and scattered small lymphocytes. The cytologic features are those of follicular dendritic cells within a germinal center; confirmation would require CD21, CD23 or CD35. Findings are consistent with normal germinal center constituents.

ddx.vs: RS cells have large eosinophilic inclusion-like macronucleoli and thick membranes in a mixed inflammatory background, whereas FDC nuclei have small nucleoli and delicate membranes.
FDC sarcoma forms fascicles or whorls of spindle-to-ovoid cells with atypia effacing the tissue, not individual FDCs within a germinal center.
Macrophages have abundant cytoplasm containing phagocytosed apoptotic debris and a single nucleus, whereas FDCs are often binucleate without ingested material.
